source.book: KET青少版官方真题2（扫描版）

parts.1:
Test One. There are five parts to the test. You will hear each piece twice. We will now stop for a moment. Please ask any questions now because you must NOT speak during the test.
PART 1
Now look at the instructions for Part One.
For each question, choose the correct answer. Look at question one.
Question 1
One. When is the party?
Boy: Are you coming to my birthday party?
Girl: Yeah, when is it?
Boy: I wanted to have it this Saturday – the 16th – but my dad's away for work. So I chose next Saturday instead – that's the 23rd. My birthday's actually on the 20th but I don't mind.
Girl: Great! Can't wait.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
Question 2
Two. What time does the football match begin?
Dad: Aren't you playing football this afternoon?
Girl: Yeah, Dad, I'm going to get my things in a minute.
Dad: But it's already half past two.
Girl: I know, but we aren't playing till half past three today – our teacher can't get there till quarter past.
Dad: Oh, OK. We can leave home a bit later then.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
Question 3
Three. Which T-shirt would the boy like?
Boy: I love the picture on that T-shirt, Mum.
Mum: Oh, is that a lion on the front?
Boy: I mean the other one, with the skateboard on it. It's over there, next to the one with the moon on it, look!
Mum: Yeah, I really like that. Shall we get it?
Now listen again.
[repeat]
Question 4
Four. How much has the girl paid for each ticket?
Girl: I've got the tickets for the school concert!
Boy: Great – I'll give you the money tomorrow – six pounds fifty, right?
Girl: That's right. It's good that my dad booked them online because you have to pay more on the day of the concert – they're eighty-five then.
Boy: Two pounds twenty-five extra! That's a lot!
Girl: Yeah, it is.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
Question 5
Five. Who did they have dinner with yesterday evening?
Woman: It was great last night. I love it when someone else joins us for dinner.
Boy: Yeah – it was nice to spend time with my classmate Ben!
Woman: By the way, who was that who picked him up afterwards? Was it his dad?
Boy: Actually, it was his grandad.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
That is the end of Part One.
parts.2:
PART 2
Now look at Part Two.
For each question, write the correct answer in the gap. Write one word or a number or a date or a time. Look at questions 6–10 now. You have 10 seconds.
You will hear a teacher talking to pupils about a school trip.
Man: Right. I want to tell you about the school nature trip, which is on the 23rd of March. Now, when we asked you about the trip, a few people wanted to go to the river. But actually, the forest was even more popular. And we haven't been before, so that's where we're going.
Our coach will leave school at 8:45, so please get here no later than 8:35. We don't want anyone to be late please.
Now, you'll need to think about what to wear. You'll need a coat to keep warm. If you wear shorts or anything like that, I think you'll be too cold.
We'll have a guide. His name's Dan Pilsey, and I'll spell that: P-I-L-S-E-Y, because I'd like you to read about him online before we go. He made a great film about monkeys. You won't see any of those but try to find some of the horses which live in the area. Now, any questions?
Now listen again.
[repeat]
That is the end of Part Two.
parts.3:
PART 3
Now look at Part Three.
For each question, choose the correct answer. Look at questions 11–15 now. You have 20 seconds.
You will hear two friends talking about their chess club.
Girl: I'm glad our teacher told us about chess club.
Boy: I already knew about it. My dad saw an ad in a magazine for it and said I should join.
Girl: What do you like about the club?
Boy: Well, the coach is really good.
Girl: And being in competitions is fun.
Boy: Only if you win, and I never do. Spending time with the other players is the best thing.
Girl: True.
Boy: Why didn't you come last week?
Girl: I went to see grandma in hospital. She had a terrible headache but she's home now. Tonight she's helping me with my history homework.
Boy: Great.
Girl: Did you have a good time last week?
Boy: I played with Alex. I lost but it was a good game. I wanted to take some team photos, but unfortunately I left my mobile at home. I missed the bus and walked home.
Girl: Oh!
Boy: Are you coming next week?
Girl: Yes, and I'm going to the cinema afterwards. Would you like to come?
Boy: I have football then, but let's have a sandwich at the café in the shopping centre before that.
Girl: OK.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
That is the end of Part Three.
parts.4:
PART 4
Now look at Part Four.
For each question, choose the correct answer.
Question 16
Sixteen. You will hear a brother and sister talking. What does the girl want the boy to do?
Boy: I'm hungry. Shall we ask Mum if we can have a pizza?
Girl: OK, I've just got to finish my homework first.
Boy: Do you want help with it? I'm good at history.
Girl: Thanks, but it's not hard. Pass me my phone. I'll check my spelling, then I'll be ready. I'd love some juice if you're not doing anything...
Boy: OK, hold on a moment.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
Question 17
Seventeen. You will hear a girl talking to her teacher. What should the girl try to do in the future?
Girl: What do I need to get better at next term, Mr Howard?
Man: You've worked very hard this term, Mary. Your homework's always been done on time.
Girl: Thank you.
Teacher: And you always say something interesting when we're discussing things. But… sometimes it takes you a bit too long to finish an exercise.
Girl: OK. I'll try to do something about that.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
Question 18
Eighteen. You will hear a girl talking about her new bag. Why did she choose this bag?
Boy: Is that a new bag?
Girl: Yes, do you like it? I wasn't sure about getting a green one.
Boy: So, why did you get it?
Girl: It was the only one left and the discount was great. The colour's not too bad, is it? Unfortunately, it's slightly too small for my books. Maybe it'll be OK for my swimming kit though.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
Question 19
Nineteen. You will hear a girl talking to her mother. Why does the girl want to give her jacket to her cousin?
Girl: Can I give my blue jacket to my cousin?
Mum: The one with the tiny pockets?
Girl: That's right. I've grown since I got it. Soon it'll look as if I've borrowed it from my little sister!
Mum: Don't you like the colour?
Girl: I do. But I'd like to get a new one, probably the same colour though.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
Question 20
Twenty. You will hear a boy telling his mother about a geography lesson. What did he enjoy most about the lesson?
Girl: How was geography today, Nick?
Boy: Good. We watched a video about deserts. That was OK. Then we worked in groups to find out all we could about one particular desert. Ours was the Sahara. I drew a map and the others looked online for information. It was fun and I felt really proud because what I did looked great.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
That is the end of Part Four.
parts.5:
PART 5
Now look at Part Five.
For each question, choose the correct answer. Look at questions 21–25 now. You have 15 seconds.
You will hear a boy telling his sister about the activities his friends did at the weekend. What activity did each friend do?
Boy: All my friends were really busy this weekend!
Girl: What did Alec do?
Boy: He finished his school history project!
Girl: Great!
Boy: Angela did something more interesting. She's in a band, so she practised all weekend. They use a room above a shop.
Girl: Oh yeah, she told me. And what about Marvin – doesn't he usually go swimming at the weekend?
Boy: Yes, but this weekend he went away to stay with his granny and grandad, so he couldn't.
Girl: What about Diane?
Boy: She had to go and choose a present for her dad's birthday, so she went to a department store. She wanted to get him some cooking things.
Girl: Nice!
Boy: Gavin visited a castle. It was built in the 14th century, he said. And they were lucky, because there was a free jazz concert while they were there.
Girl: Yeah, he told me. What did Lucy do?
Boy: Her grandparents were staying at her house. She wanted to go to the swimming pool, but her grandmother wanted to play chess. So that's what they did – the whole weekend!
Now listen again.
[repeat]
That is the end of Part Five.
You now have six minutes to write your answers on the answer sheet.
[ping]
You have one more minute.
[ping]
That is the end of the test.

explanations.p1q1: 男孩原本想在 16 日举办，生日实际在 20 日；但爸爸出差，所以最后改在下周六 23 日，因此选择 C。他说 "I wanted to have it this Saturday – the 16th – but my dad's away for work. So I chose next Saturday instead – that's the 23rd."，又补了一句 "My birthday's actually on the 20th but I don't mind."。
explanations.p1q2: 女孩说 "I know, but we aren't playing till half past three today – our teacher can't get there till quarter past."，两点半是现在的时间，三点一刻是老师能到的时间；比赛开始时间是三点半，因此选择 C。
explanations.p1q3: 男孩不是要狮子图案，而是指带滑板的那件："I mean the other one, with the skateboard on it."；月亮图案只是用来说明位置（"It's over there, next to the one with the moon on it, look!"），因此选择 B。
explanations.p1q4: 女孩的爸爸提前在网上订票，男孩确认 "six pounds fifty, right?" 后女孩答 "That's right."，每张票是 £6.50；"you have to pay more on the day of the concert"，演出当天购买才更贵（男孩："Two pounds twenty-five extra! That's a lot!"），因此选择 B。
explanations.p1q5: 他们和同学 Ben 一起吃晚饭，男孩说 "it was nice to spend time with my classmate Ben!"；之后来接 Ben 的是他的爷爷（"Actually, it was his grandad."），不是一起用餐的人，因此选择 C。
explanations.p2q1: 老师说 "a few people wanted to go to the river. But actually, the forest was even more popular. And we haven't been before, so that's where we're going."，最终去的是森林，因此填 forest；river 只是少数人想去的地方。
explanations.p2q2: 老师说 "Our coach will leave school at 8:45, so please get here no later than 8:35."，大巴 8:45 出发，最晚要 8:35 到校，因此填 8:35；8:45 是发车时间，不要误填。
explanations.p2q3: 老师提醒着装 "You'll need a coat to keep warm. If you wear shorts or anything like that, I think you'll be too cold."，要穿保暖的外套，因此填 coat；短裤会太冷。
explanations.p2q4: 老师说 "We'll have a guide. His name's Dan Pilsey, and I'll spell that: P-I-L-S-E-Y"，向导名叫 Dan Pilsey，题中已给出 Dan，因此填姓氏 Pilsey。
explanations.p2q5: 老师说向导拍过猴子纪录片，但 "You won't see any of those but try to find some of the horses which live in the area."，到时要找的是当地生活的马，因此填 horse(s)；猴子是看不到的干扰信息。
explanations.p3q1: 女孩说 "I'm glad our teacher told us about chess club."，男孩却说 "I already knew about it. My dad saw an ad in a magazine for it and said I should join."，爸爸在杂志上看到广告后告诉了男孩；男孩是从爸爸那里得知的，因此选择 A。
explanations.p3q2: 男孩说 "Well, the coach is really good."，女孩说 "And being in competitions is fun."，但男孩补充 "Only if you win, and I never do. Spending time with the other players is the best thing."，教练和比赛都被提到，但两人都认同和其他成员在一起最好，因此选择 C。
explanations.p3q3: 男孩问 "Why didn't you come last week?"，女孩答 "I went to see grandma in hospital. She had a terrible headache but she's home now."，头痛的是她的奶奶；女孩上周是去医院探望奶奶，因此选择 B。
explanations.p3q4: 男孩说 "I played with Alex. I lost but it was a good game. I wanted to take some team photos, but unfortunately I left my mobile at home."，男孩输了比赛却觉得比赛不错；他遗憾的是忘带手机，没能拍队伍照片，因此选择 A；"I missed the bus and walked home." 只是回家经过，不是他难受的原因。
explanations.p3q5: 女孩说 "Yes, and I'm going to the cinema afterwards. Would you like to come?"，男孩说 "I have football then, but let's have a sandwich at the café in the shopping centre before that."，女孩要去看电影，男孩那时要踢足球；他们约好俱乐部活动前在购物中心的咖啡馆吃三明治，因此选择 B。
explanations.p4q1: 男孩先提出帮忙做作业，女孩说 "Thanks, but it's not hard."，自己拿手机查拼写就好；她接着说 "I'd love some juice if you're not doing anything..."，男孩回 "OK, hold on a moment."，她真正想要男孩做的是去拿喝的（果汁），因此选择 B。
explanations.p4q2: 老师先夸 "Your homework's always been done on time."，也说她讨论时 "you always say something interesting"，但指出 "sometimes it takes you a bit too long to finish an exercise."，女孩回 "OK. I'll try to do something about that."，今后要改进的是做题太慢、要更快，因此选择 B。
explanations.p4q3: 女孩解释买包的原因："It was the only one left and the discount was great."，折扣划算才是主因；颜色只是 "not too bad"，尺寸反而 "slightly too small for my books"，因此选择 C（for the price）。
explanations.p4q4: 女孩说 "I've grown since I got it. Soon it'll look as if I've borrowed it from my little sister!"，人长大了外套就不够大，因此选择 A；"The one with the tiny pockets?" 是妈妈先提到的小口袋，颜色她也喜欢（"I do."），都不是原因。
explanations.p4q5: 男孩说看沙漠视频 "That was OK."，上网查资料的是其他同学（"the others looked online for information"）；他自己画地图后 "I felt really proud because what I did looked great."，最享受的是画地图，因此选择 B。
explanations.p5q1: 男孩说 "Angela did something more interesting. She's in a band, so she practised all weekend."，Angela 整个周末和乐队排练，对应 playing music，因此选 E。
explanations.p5q2: 女孩问 Marvin 周末不是常去游泳吗（"doesn't he usually go swimming at the weekend?"），男孩说 "this weekend he went away to stay with his granny and grandad, so he couldn't."，这个周末去看望祖父母，对应 visiting grandparents，因此选 H；swimming 只是他平时常做、这次没去成的活动。
explanations.p5q3: 男孩说 Diane "had to go and choose a present for her dad's birthday, so she went to a department store."，去百货商店为爸爸挑生日礼物，对应 shopping，因此选 F；"get him some cooking things" 只是买的礼物，不是她去下厨。
explanations.p5q4: 男孩说 "Gavin visited a castle. It was built in the 14th century, he said."，参观 14 世纪的古老城堡对应 going to see an old building，因此选 C；城堡里恰逢 "a free jazz concert"，不是他自己演奏音乐。
explanations.p5q5: 男孩说 Lucy 本想去游泳，"but her grandmother wanted to play chess. So that's what they did – the whole weekend!"，和奶奶下了一整个周末国际象棋，对应 playing a board game，因此选 D；swimming pool 只是她没去成的地方。

uncertain: p1q4: 原文印作 "they're eighty-five then"，与上下文（每张 £6.50、当天贵 "Two pounds twenty-five extra" 即约 £8.75）存在数学出入；已按页面逐字转录，解析中未引用该句。
